scenes.title: The Midnight Crisis
scenes.subtitle: The Golden Hour Clock Starts
scenes.location: Modest Kolkata living room, wooden sofa, wall clock reading 1:15 AM
scenes.action_description: Grandmother Bani Devi clutches her mid-chest with a clenched right fist in acute agony (Levine's sign), eyes squeezed shut, cold sweat, labored breathing. Mother Ananya rushes into the frame with a trembling glass of water in sheer terror, paralyzed and unsure how to act.
scenes.clinical_context: Acute ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI), ESI-1 Immediate Resuscitation. Layman instinct to give water risks pulmonary aspiration during cardiogenic shock; laying patient flat exacerbates pulmonary venous congestion.
scenes.technical_context: Emergency severity clock initialized at 00:00. Requires sub-60-minute door-to-treatment time to preserve myocardium.

visual_composition.camera_angle: Eye-level medium shot centered on living room sofa
visual_composition.lighting: Warm midnight lamplight contrasting with deep slate-navy shadows
visual_composition.background: Isolated clean solid white background (#FFFFFF) with zero clutter

dialogue_bubbles.speaker: char_grandmother
dialogue_bubbles.bengali_script: বুকে যেন পাথর চেপে বসেছে... শ্বাস নিতে পারছি না!
dialogue_bubbles.english_subtitle: My chest feels crushed by a boulder... I can't breathe!
dialogue_bubbles.clinical_rationale: Classic Levine's sign retrosternal angina radiating to left arm.

scenes.title: The Panicked Reality & Ghost Bed Dilemma
scenes.subtitle: Reading is Not Reserving
scenes.location: Living room center table with open laptop, scribbled notepad, and mobile phone
scenes.action_description: Mother Ananya clutches her phone to her ear with white-knuckled grip, other hand on forehead in despair. Her notepad shows crossed-out lines: 'RG Kar - Line Busy', 'Medical College - 0 ICU Beds', 'ILS - No Oxygen'. Laptop screen shows static portal displaying 'Available ICU Beds: 4', but nurse on phone rejects admission: 'Beds occupied since 8 PM, nurse staff nai!'. Stuck ambulance with flashing siren seen through window.
scenes.clinical_context: The 2.4 Hospital Gate Rejection Cycle in urban India. The Ghost Bed Paradox: Portals count physical metal frames without verifying 1:1 ICU nurse staffing ratios.
scenes.technical_context: Static government portals fail due to batch update delays (6+ hour staleness) and lack of atomic reservation capability.

visual_composition.camera_angle: Medium close-up showing Mother's terrified expression and scribbled notepad
visual_composition.lighting: Cold blue light from laptop screen contrasting with alert crimson rejection badges

dialogue_bubbles.speaker: char_mother
dialogue_bubbles.bengali_script: সরকারি পোর্টালে দেখাচ্ছে ৪টি আইসিইউ বেড খালি আছে! অথচ নার্স ফোনে বলছে একজনও রোগী ভর্তি নেওয়া যাবে না?!
dialogue_bubbles.english_subtitle: The government dashboard shows 4 ICU beds available! Why did the nurse just tell me they can't admit her?!
dialogue_bubbles.clinical_rationale: Directly exposes the Ghost Bed Paradox and static portal failure.

scenes.title: The Smart Solution
scenes.subtitle: Bengali Voice Triage & 15-Minute Dynamic Soft-Lock
scenes.location: Living room center stage, illuminated by glowing smartphone display
scenes.action_description: Teen Granddaughter Riya steps in with poised calm, holding her glowing phone running ashaien.vercel.app. She taps the glowing cyan mic icon and speaks colloquial Bengali. The screen instantly displays ESI-1 Critical alert, locks a staffed ICU bed at Calcutta National Medical College (CNMC, 2.8 km, 14 min), activates a 15-minute countdown timer (14:59), and generates 4-digit admission OTP 4892.
scenes.clinical_context: Deterministic AHRQ ESI v4 acuity classification. Sub-millisecond symptom parsing triggers immediate Cardiac ICU allocation.
scenes.technical_context: Client-side W3C Web Speech streaming + in-memory Bengali normalizer (0ms API latency, $0 cost). Atomic PostgreSQL row lock (SELECT FOR UPDATE) decrements staffed bed inventory across the state network.

visual_composition.camera_angle: Medium hero shot of Riya holding glowing phone toward viewer with confident posture
visual_composition.lighting: Vibrant electric cyan (#00F0FF) UI glow illuminating characters against pure white

dialogue_bubbles.bengali_script: দিদার বুকে তীব্র ব্যথা করছে আর শ্বাস নিতে কষ্ট হচ্ছে!
dialogue_bubbles.english_subtitle: Dida has severe chest pain and is struggling to breathe!
dialogue_bubbles.clinical_rationale: Spoken Bengali symptom triggering ESI-1 triage and 0ms in-memory translation.

dialogue_bubbles.speaker: char_granddaughter
dialogue_bubbles.bengali_script: মা, ফোন ছাড়ো! ASHA বাংলায় শুনে ০ সেকেন্ডে CNMC হাসপাতালে বেড লক করে দিয়েছে! আমাদের ওটিপি ৪৮৯২!
dialogue_bubbles.english_subtitle: Ma, hang up! ASHA understood me in Bengali and locked a bed at CNMC in 0 seconds! Our OTP is 4892!
dialogue_bubbles.clinical_rationale: Replaces panic with concrete action, 15-minute countdown, and 4-digit gate pass.

scenes.title: Bridging the Transit Void
scenes.subtitle: Situational First-Aid & GPS Telemetry Loop
scenes.location: Backseat of moving family vehicle / ambulance en route to CNMC
scenes.action_description: Grandmother Bani Devi is seated upright propped at a strict 45-degree angle (Semi-Fowler posture) supported by firm cushions, collar unbuttoned, chewing a 300mg soluble aspirin; her breathing is visibly calmer. Mother Ananya gently comforts her. Granddaughter Riya monitors her smartphone showing a live green directional GPS vector line connecting the moving car to the hospital icon, with dynamic ETA 11 min and active anti-hoarding telemetry.
scenes.clinical_context: ERC 2021/2025 and AIIMS Emergency Medicine First-Aid Protocols: Semi-Fowler 45° posture reduces venous return to ischemic left ventricle by 22%, easing pulmonary congestion; 300mg aspirin inhibits thromboxane A2 platelet aggregation, reducing 30-day mortality by 23%.
scenes.technical_context: 10-second GPS vector heartbeat verifies directional velocity (v · d > 0). Moving toward hospital pauses countdown timer; stationary or diverging vehicles auto-cancel hold after timeout.

visual_composition.camera_angle: Three-quarter side angle inside vehicle cabin showing 45-degree elevation and phone screen
visual_composition.lighting: Dynamic transit motion accents, green telemetry line glow

dialogue_bubbles.speaker: char_mother
dialogue_bubbles.bengali_script: দিদাকে কি গাড়ির সিটে শুইয়ে দেব? একটু জল খাইয়ে দিই?!
dialogue_bubbles.english_subtitle: Should I lay her flat on the car seat and give her some water?!
dialogue_bubbles.clinical_rationale: Exposes common lethal layman misconceptions in cardiac arrest transit.

dialogue_bubbles.speaker: char_granddaughter
dialogue_bubbles.bengali_script: একদম না, মা! ASHA-র নির্দেশ: কখনোই শোয়ানো যাবে না! ৪৫ ডিগ্রি তুলে বসিয়ে দাও আর এই ৩০০ মিলিগ্রাম অ্যাসপিরিন চিবিয়ে খেতে দাও!
dialogue_bubbles.english_subtitle: Strictly NO, Ma! ASHA protocol warns: Never lay a cardiac patient flat! Prop her up at 45 degrees and have her chew this 300mg aspirin!
dialogue_bubbles.clinical_rationale: Actionable AIIMS/ERC protocol application bridging transit mortality.

scenes.title: The Resuscitation & Relief
scenes.subtitle: Golden Hour Preserved via 2-Second OTP Admission
scenes.location: Emergency Department Resuscitation Bay Entrance at CNMC
scenes.action_description: Paramedic wheels Grandmother on gurney into ER bay; vital signs monitor shows stable sinus rhythm (SpO2 96%). Dr. Arindam Banerjee taps 4-digit OTP 4892 into hospital triage tablet terminal (ashaien-admin.vercel.app). Screen flashes green: 'PATIENT ADMITTED — CARDIAC ICU BED 04 SECURED — GEOFENCE VERIFIED (35m)'. Doctor gives confident thumbs-up to family: 'Total transit: 42 minutes! The 45° posture and zero gate delay kept her heart alive. She is going straight to Cath Lab!'. Mother weeps tears of joy in namaste; Riya smiles proudly.
scenes.clinical_context: Door-to-treatment time achieved in 42 minutes, well inside the 60-minute Golden Hour. Door-to-balloon time preserved for primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
scenes.technical_context: 100-meter Haversine geofence verification confirms patient physical presence at hospital bay before hard-lock conversion. Total check-in time 1.8 seconds via WebSocket sync (<50ms).

visual_composition.camera_angle: Wide triumphant resuscitation bay shot with Dr. Banerjee in foreground giving thumbs-up
visual_composition.lighting: Bright clinical hospital lighting, warm emotional resolution

dialogue_bubbles.speaker: char_doctor
dialogue_bubbles.bengali_script: ৪৮৯২ এন্টার করলাম... অ্যাডমিটেড! মোট সময় লাগল ১.৮ সেকেন্ড! আপনারা ৪২ মিনিটে পৌঁছাতে পেরেছেন বলেই ওনার হার্ট সুরক্ষিত আছে। আমরা সোজা ক্যাথ ল্যাবে নিয়ে যাচ্ছি!
dialogue_bubbles.english_subtitle: Entered 4-8-9-2... Admitted in 1.8 seconds! You reached us in 42 minutes, keeping her myocardium intact. She is going straight to the Cath Lab!
dialogue_bubbles.clinical_rationale: Validates Golden Hour salvation and clinical soundness of platform.

dialogue_bubbles.speaker: char_mother
dialogue_bubbles.bengali_script: ASHA না থাকলে আমরা তো অন্য হাসপাতালের বন্ধ দরজায় ধাক্কা খেতে খেতেই সব হারাতাম... ডাক্তারবাবু, আপনারাই দিদাকে বাঁচালেন!
dialogue_bubbles.english_subtitle: Without ASHA, we would have lost everything wandering blindly between closed gates... you saved our Dida's life!
dialogue_bubbles.clinical_rationale: Emotional resolution of the 2.4 hospital gate rejection cycle.

dialogue_matrix.typical_judge_skepticism: What stops private ambulance drivers, brokers, or touts from locking all 20 ICU beds on burner SIM cards?
dialogue_matrix.bengali_script: একদম পারবে না, মা! ASHA প্রতি ১০ সেকেন্ডে আমাদের গাড়ির GPS মুভমেন্ট ট্র্যাক করে। গাড়ি হাসপাতালের দিকে না এগোলে বুকিং নিজে থেকেই বাতিল হয়ে যায়! আর ৫০% বেড তো হাসপাতালের গেটের জন্য সংরক্ষিত!
dialogue_matrix.english_translation: They can't, Ma! ASHA tracks our car's GPS vector every 10 seconds. If a vehicle doesn't move toward the hospital, the hold auto-cancels! Plus, public holds are strictly capped at 50%!
dialogue_matrix.technical_defense: 10-second directional velocity vector loop (v · d > 0); 50% public hold cap; 100m Great-Circle Haversine geofence gate check.

dialogue_matrix.typical_judge_skepticism: State government portals already show bed availability. Why did they fail during COVID and emergencies?
dialogue_matrix.bengali_script: কারণ ওই পোর্টালে শুধু লোহার খাট গোনা হয়, মা! ১:১ স্পেশালিস্ট নার্স ছাড়া আইসিইউ বেড তো আসলে ফাঁকা কঙ্কাল! ASHA শুধু সেই বেডই লক করে যার জন্য অন-ডিউটি নার্স উপস্থিত আছেন!
dialogue_matrix.english_translation: Because that dashboard counts metal furniture, Ma! An ICU bed without an on-duty 1:1 critical care nurse is a ghost bed. ASHA only locks beds that have an active nurse assigned right now!
dialogue_matrix.technical_defense: Clinical Staffing Ratio formula: B_staffed = min(B_phys, N_nurses * Ratio). Eliminates gate rejections caused by unstaffed equipment.

dialogue_matrix.typical_judge_skepticism: In rural Bengal or severe panic, ordinary citizens cannot type complex English medical terms.
dialogue_matrix.bengali_script: ইংরেজি বলতে হবে না, মা! বাংলায় স্বাভাবিকভাবে বলো: 'দিদার বুকে তীব্র ব্যথা করছে আর ঘাম হচ্ছে'। ASHA ফোনের ভেতরেই ০ মিলিসেকেন্ডে আমাদের কথা ডাক্তারি ভাষায় বুঝে নেয়!
dialogue_matrix.english_translation: No English needed, Ma! Just speak naturally in Bengali: 'Dida has severe chest pain and sweating'. ASHA translates spoken Bengali into clinical ESI-1 in 0 milliseconds right inside the phone!
dialogue_matrix.technical_defense: Continuous W3C Web Speech API + in-memory deterministic Bengali normalizer. Zero cloud LLM API cost, zero network latency, zero hallucinations.

dialogue_matrix.typical_judge_skepticism: Even if a bed is locked, what stops the patient from dying during the 40-minute drive?
dialogue_matrix.bengali_script: একদম না, মা! ASHA-র এইমস (AIIMS) নির্দেশিকা দেখো: হার্ট অ্যাটাকের রোগীকে কখনোই শোয়ানো যাবে না! ৪৫ ডিগ্রি তুলে বসিয়ে দাও যাতে ফুসফুসে চাপ না পড়ে, আর এই ৩০০ মিলিগ্রাম অ্যাসপিরিন চিবিয়ে খেতে দাও!
dialogue_matrix.english_translation: Strictly NO, Ma! ASHA's AIIMS protocol warns: Never lay a cardiac patient flat! Prop her up at 45 degrees so her lungs don't flood, and have her chew this 300mg soluble aspirin!
dialogue_matrix.technical_defense: ERC 2021/2025 & AIIMS Emergency Protocols: Semi-Fowler 45° posture cuts left-ventricular preload by 22%; 300mg aspirin cuts 30-day mortality by 23%.

dialogue_matrix.typical_judge_skepticism: Why not use Apollo 24/7 or Practo? Why create another web app?
dialogue_matrix.bengali_script: কোনো অ্যাপ ডাউনলোড বা পাসওয়ার্ড লাগবে না! বিপদের সময় কেউ পাসওয়ার্ড মনে রাখে না। যেকোনো ফোনের ব্রাউজারে ASHA খোলে মাত্র ০.৮ সেকেন্ডে। এক ট্যাপে কথা বলো, বেড লক!
dialogue_matrix.english_translation: No app downloads or passwords! In an emergency, nobody remembers passwords. ASHA loads on any phone browser in 0.8 seconds. One tap, speak symptom, bed locked!
dialogue_matrix.technical_defense: Zero-signup responsive PWA (<1.4MB bundle); instant execution without login credentials, SMS gates, or credit card holds.

dialogue_matrix.typical_judge_skepticism: At 2:00 AM in heavy rain, scanning phone QR codes or biometric readers fails and takes too long.
dialogue_matrix.bengali_script: ৪৮৯২ এন্টার করলাম... অ্যাডমিটেড! বেড নম্বর ৪ প্রস্তুত। কোনো ফর্ম ফিলাপ বা লাইনের ঝামেলা নেই। মোট সময় লাগল ১.৮ সেকেন্ড!
dialogue_matrix.english_translation: Entered 4-8-9-2... Admitted! Cardiac ICU Bed #4 ready. Zero paperwork, zero registration line. Total check-in time: 1.8 seconds!
dialogue_matrix.technical_defense: 4-digit spoken numeric OTP eliminates optical scanner failures and wet phone glare; sub-50ms Supabase PostgreSQL WebSocket state transition.

dialogue_matrix.typical_judge_skepticism: Private hospitals charge exorbitant admission deposits, while government hospitals are congested. How does ASHA help families choose?
dialogue_matrix.bengali_script: দেখো মা, ASHA দুটো অপশনই পাশাপাশি দেখাচ্ছে: সবচেয়ে কাছের সরকারি হাসপাতাল (CNMC, ১৪ মিনিট, সম্পূর্ণ বিনামূল্যে) আর বেসরকারি হাসপাতাল (ILS, ৮ মিনিট)। আমরা CNMC বেছে নিয়েছি—বেড নিশ্চিত, কোনো ডিপোজিটের ভয় নেই!
dialogue_matrix.english_translation: Look Ma, ASHA shows both options side-by-side: Nearest Free Government Hospital (CNMC, 14 min, ₹0) vs Private (ILS, 8 min). We chose CNMC—bed guaranteed, zero admission deposit shock!
dialogue_matrix.technical_defense: Dual-tier emergency routing transparency prevents catastrophic out-of-pocket medical expenditure during high-vulnerability panic.
